the Kurdish political parties and their supporters are not a homogenous group, but rather are a collection of different political actors with different ideologies, agendas, and goals.

the following questions: How do we understand the emergence and development of Kurdish nationalisms in Turkey and in the Kurdistan region of Iraq?
the impact of the US presence on Kurdish nationalism in Turkey and in Northern Iraq and the role of the US military in redefining Kurdishness.
the impact of the United States military presence in the Middle East on Kurdish nationalisms.

the US military presence is a major factor in re-organizing the political and cultural landscape of the Middle East.
the Turkish government has a policy towards the Kurdish question in Turkey.

the Kurdish question is a question of nationhood.
the Kurdish issue is not just about the Kurdish issue; it is about the Kurdish issue in Turkey, Iraq, Iran, and Syria.
we have been trying to understand the ways in which global forces are impacting on local and regional politics and the ways in which local and regional politics in turn impact on global politics.
